headline: Northern Arc's new private credit fund raises over Rs 400 crore in first close
hook: Fresh capital target set at Rs 1,500 crore
summary: Northern Arc Investment Managers has achieved the first close of its 15th private credit fund by raising over Rs 400 crore. The fund targets a total corpus of Rs 1,500 crore with an expected XIRR of 16 percent. This follows the maturity of the firm's India Impact Fund, which deployed Rs 1,398 crore. Retail investors tracking NBFC sector debt vehicles can note this ongoing private credit fundraising.
whats_next: Final close of the Rs 1,500 crore fund corpus
why_it_matters: Private credit expansion highlights ongoing non-bank institutional funding demand.
